subject: Faster auto-complete function with multiple inputs?

messages.author: 47bf5286bc936be3
messages.subject: Faster auto-complete function with multiple inputs?
parts:
Hi everyone, 

We are trying to use as an auto-complete feature for input from a large list of genes (30,000 or so). We've had success using textInput.typeahead() from the ShinySky package, but unfortunately it only allows for one input, and we are trying to expand to allow the user to input multiple inputs. We have tried functions select2Input() and selectizeInput(), but both of them take a long time to load (~20 seconds or so), although they work very well once finished loading. Does anyone have any ideas on a possible solution? Thanks.

Daniel

messages.subject: Re: Faster auto-complete function with multiple inputs?
parts:
Check out the section on "server side selectize" on this page: http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/selectize.html

30,000 should be no sweat for server mode selectize--if you find otherwise please let us know. Thanks!
